frame: robot: x forward,y left,z up; hip-axis origin

mount_json.what: the turret's interface for the body (docs/turret-next-plan.md 3.1, task N5)
mount_json.frame: the TM frame: x forward, y left, z up (mm), the origin on the pan axis in the TM face (the pan base's foot, D76); cad/turret.py's frame T (the pan base's foot) is frame_t_above_face_mm above it
mount_json.written_by: cad/build_turret.py through cad/turret_mount.py, from the CAD as built

tm.dowel_pin: Ø5 x 16, 2 off: not symmetric, the turret goes on one way only
tm.hole_use: unused on the robot: the harness leaves by the DT12, nothing passes the hole
tm.foot: D76: the pan base's foot (cad/turret.py pan_base) flat on the head's TM face, its Ø65 centre opening over the Ø45 TM hole; no compute plinth (D66 superseded)
tm.source: cad/turret.py TM_BOLTS, TM_DOWELS, TM_HOLE, Geo.base_r / foot_t / bumper_r, pan_base(); the screw and pin lengths from exports/turret/bench/bom.json (hw_tm_screws, hw_tm_dowels)

riser.decision: D41: a printed riser on the top deck, open sides
riser.top_ring: solid under the four bolts and the two dowels; nothing of it inside the DT plug boxes (dt12.boxes)
riser.inserts: 4 x M5 heat-set, pilots Ø6.4, at least bolt_hole_depth_min_mm deep
riser.dowel_holes: 2 x Ø5 H7 (reamed), at least 12.5 mm deep: 4 mm of each 16 mm pin is in the pan base's foot
riser.source: docs/body-plan.md 1.1 (D41); the depths from the screw and pin lengths and cad/turret.py pan_base() (D76: the M5 heads on the 5 mm foot's top, the dowel holes 4 mm into it from below)

dt12.plug: DT06-12SA with its W12S wedge (te-dt06-12sa-kit), a 1011-248-1205 90 deg backshell turning the harness down
dt12.side: -y: the turret's right, which is the robot's right (the base does not pan)

box_notes.plug_body: the DT06 standing proud of the flange (cad/turret.py bought_parts dt_plug)
box_notes.plug_backshell: the 90 deg backshell down to the deck (est size; cad/turret.py bought_parts dt_plug)
box_notes.withdrawal_sweep: the plug body's 30 mm path out, which cad/turret.py clashes() sweeps against the fixed parts
box_notes.backshell_withdrawal: the backshell's 30 mm path out: below the TM face, the body's side (riser, deck, grommet); not in the turret's clash sweep

dt12.plug_in_with: the turret parked and the body's turret branch off (the stop relay open)
dt12.source: cad/turret.py DT, DT_Z (in frame T) + FRAME_T_ABOVE_TM, Geo.dt_y, bought_parts() (dt_receptacle, dt_plug), clashes() (the sweep box); docs/turret-wiring.md 1.1

pins.signal: +BUS (D76: the body's 10S turret branch, 30-42 V; the stand's DCB609, 15-20.5 V)

pins.wire: 24 AWG twisted pair: the dry safety loop, closed = run

harness.in_the_turret: the 10 A MINI 58 V (fuse_mini58_10a) in its in-line holder (littelfuse-0fhm0001zxj) in the lead from the DT12 to the base board, then D8 (1N5408): a reversed supply blows the fuse (D76: the power is on pins 1-4 again, as before D66)
harness.safety_contact: across pins 7-8: a dry contact, closed = run, rated for 12 V at 2 mA (the base 555's pulse loop); opens on the radio stop, on the receiver's failsafe and when the robot sits (D37, D52)

mass.pose: pan 0, tilt 0 (the centre turns with pan about the pan axis)
mass.budget: D79: no mass ceiling (the owner took out D71's weight budget); the body's TM checks take the head at 1.70 kg or more, the centre at most 100 mm above the TM face, or the real one when higher
mass.source: cad/turret.py mass_properties() (printed parts by the printed-part model, bought parts at their catalogue masses, the not-modelled allowance at the turntable)

power.never_stepped: the firmware always ramps the flywheels (config.RAMP_S); a stepped start (stepped_start_a) is never used on the robot
power.bank: 2 x 1000 uF 35 V low ESR (panasonic-eeu-fr1j471b) across the ring's +24 V on the turret boards' level 1 (the power model in exports/turret/e2e/power.json assumed 3 x 1,000 uF)
power.hot_plug: plug and unplug the DT12 only with the body's turret branch off: the bank charges through the pins otherwise
power.body_side: the body's turret branch (F8, 7.5 A MINI 58 V) through the stop relay's pole B (D52), on DT12 pins 1-4 (D76)
power.source: exports/turret/e2e/power.json (ramp_sweep at the firmware's RAMP_S, verdict), firmware/turret/config.py RAMP_S, docs/turret-wiring.md 4-5 (the game average <= 1.5 A at the ring, the bank), docs/head-payload.md (40 W average), exports/turret/bench/bom.json (el_capacitors)

can.termination: the turret's Feather M4 CAN terminates its own end (120 R); the body terminates its end at the J501's can1
can.host: firmware/turret/host.py: SocketCAN can1 on the Jetson (the J501's second port), a gs_usb USB-CAN as can0 on the laptop

made_for.frame: cad/turret_lidar.py's: its heights are against frame T (the pan base's foot, 0 mm above the TM face since D76), the same as this file's TM frame

lidar_clearance.firmware_default: firmware/turret/config.py ROBOT_DEPRESSION: the same table, which the firmware holds for mount robot while no table is loaded
lidar_clearance.rule: the table holds only for the lidar where made_for puts it: regenerate it (cad/turret_lidar.py --x <lidar to pan>) when the lidar or the turret moves; the host loads it (firmware/turret/host.py --mount robot)

recoil.pan_moment: zero: the ball path lies in the pan axis's plane (y = 0) and both tyres push alike

aim.pan: continuous (the slip ring), at most 90 deg/s (the servo through 3:1)
aim.tilt_rule: D77: the mechanical hard stops only; every goal clamps into them, and firing stops above the feed's qualified elevation (exports/turret/limits.json fire_tilt_max_deg)
aim.source: firmware/turret/config.py, cad/turret.py Geo (tilt_t, path_t in frame T) + FRAME_T_ABOVE_TM

envelope.how: every part (tilting parts at 0 and -25 deg), the robot's DT06 plug apart: z from bounding boxes in the TM frame, radii from the pan axis over the tessellated surfaces (0.1 mm, added)

mount_json.round_trip: cad/turret_mount.py --check reads this file back against cad/turret.py's TM_BOLTS, TM_DOWELS, TM_HOLE
